name: Lipschitz Constant Based Ray Tracing
definition: A method using Lipschitz bounds of the field function and its gradient to build an octree space partitioning for pruning empty areas and isolating roots.
summary: Lipschitz Constant Based Ray Tracing accelerates sphere tracing by storing local Lipschitz bounds in an octree to cull empty nodes, differing from Segment Tracing by using static cell bounds.
